scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps/api apps/web packages/api-client .github package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml docker-compose.yml
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @modern-pos/api-client typecheck && pnpm --filter @modern-pos/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @modern-pos/web typecheck
scripts.openapi:generate:dart: openapi-generator-cli generate -i API.openapi.json -g dart -c tools/openapi-dart-config.json -o packages/api_client_dart
scripts.openapi:check:dart: cd packages/api_client_dart && dart pub get && dart analyze --no-fatal-warnings
scripts.openapi:check: pnpm openapi:validate && pnpm openapi:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/api-client/src/schema.d.ts packages/api_client_dart && pnpm openapi:check:dart
scripts.mobile:format:check: cd apps/mobile && dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test
